name: Release Seal
description: Seal software releases on Bitcoin Cash. A project is a CashTokens category; its mutable NFT holds the Merkle root of the latest release files and only its holder can seal the next release or revoke one.

maintainer.name: Maintainer
maintainer.description: Holds the project NFT and seals releases.

funder.name: Funder
funder.description: Pays the maintainer coins for fees.

fund.name: Fund
fund.description: Receive coins that pay the fees of later seals.

prepareGenesisCoin.name: Prepare Genesis Coin
prepareGenesisCoin.description: Move $(<genesisSatoshis>) satoshis to output 0 of a new transaction; a project can only start from a coin at output 0.

createProject.name: Create Project
createProject.description: Start a project: mint its mutable NFT (empty release root) and write the creation record.

sealRelease.name: Seal Release
sealRelease.description: Seal a release: the project NFT takes the Merkle root of the release files as its new commitment.

revokeRelease.name: Revoke Release
revokeRelease.description: Mark a sealed release as revoked; the project NFT keeps its commitment.

prepareTransaction.name: Genesis coin prepared
prepareTransaction.description: $(<genesisSatoshis>) satoshis now sit at output 0, ready to start a project.

createProjectTransaction.name: Project created
createProjectTransaction.description: Project $(<recordVersion>) created; its category is the transaction id of the coin spent at input 0.

feeInput.name: Fee coin
feeInput.description: A plain coin of the maintainer.

genesisInput.name: Genesis coin
genesisInput.description: A plain coin at output 0 of its transaction; that transaction id becomes the project category.

projectNftInput.name: Project NFT
projectNftInput.description: The mutable project NFT of category $(<projectCategory>) with root $(<currentRoot>).

projectGenesisOutput.name: Project NFT
projectGenesisOutput.description: New project NFT with the empty release root.

projectReleaseOutput.name: Project NFT
projectReleaseOutput.description: Project NFT carrying the root of release $(<recordVersion>).

maintainerLockingScript.name: Maintainer
maintainerLockingScript.description: The maintainer address: holds the project NFT and the fee coins.

createdRecordLockingScript.name: Creation record
createdRecordLockingScript.description: OP_RETURN record of a new project.

sealedRecordLockingScript.name: Seal record
sealedRecordLockingScript.description: OP_RETURN record of a sealed release.

revokedRecordLockingScript.name: Revoke record
revokedRecordLockingScript.description: OP_RETURN record of a revoked release.

nftSatoshis.name: NFT Satoshis
nftSatoshis.description: Satoshis kept on the project NFT.

mutableCapability.name: Mutable
mutableCapability.description: The project NFT is mutable: its holder may change the commitment.

emptyRoot.name: Empty Root
emptyRoot.description: Merkle root of an empty file list: SHA-256 of nothing.

maintainerKey.name: Maintainer Key
maintainerKey.description: The key of the address that holds the project NFT.

genesisSatoshis.name: Genesis Amount
genesisSatoshis.description: Satoshis moved to output 0 for a new project.

projectCategory.name: Project
projectCategory.description: The project id: its token category.

currentRoot.name: Current Root
currentRoot.description: The commitment the project NFT carries now.

releaseRoot.name: Release Root
releaseRoot.description: Merkle root of the release files (name, size, SHA-256 of each).

recordVersion.name: Version
recordVersion.description: The release version, or the project name on creation.

recordUrl.name: File List URL
recordUrl.description: Where the release file list (seal.json) lives, or the project page on creation.
